method: Every assigned row was read in full context: word, main meaning and reading, both explanations, all components, and both complete Hanzi/pinyin/English examples with their chunks. Exact repeated example signatures and exact Hanzi/pinyin/gloss triples reuse their first reviewed source with explicit references in read_3_* and seen_3.json. Exhaustive structural checks independently cover reconstruction, syllable alignment and incomplete references. Contextual lexical-span and observed-error rules are applied without choosing dictionary senses automatically. Final 75 rows receive explicitly curated word/phrase segmentation and final contextual inspection. AI editorial review, not human linguistic approval.
remaining: No assigned row remains unread. Main-reading questions are recorded separately for the parent to adjudicate before application.

primaryReadingQuestions.reason: Mainland teaching source uses mú; Taiwan Ministry of Education uses mó. Requires explicit regional policy, preserve source until authorized.

references.finding: Ministry of Education dictionary supports swift and light.
Official historical dictionary has piǎo méi; source biāo méi is also attested at https://zdic.net/hans/摽梅; retain current main reading pending source policy.
Literary usages can mean morning-and-evening; morning-light usage is also attested in place-name poetry. Retain current selected sense, flag contextual variability.
Flora of China identifies 苘麻 as Abutilon theophrasti, not cannabis.
Chinese Academy of Sciences botanical database identifies 栝楼 as Trichosanthes kirilowii (Chinese cucumber), not the distinct snake gourd.

tailSemanticSegmentation.finalContextualRead: All final segmented examples inspected in five batches of 15 rows, followed by corrections to polysemous units, negative auxiliaries, and compounds.
tailSemanticSegmentation.vocabularySource: Explicit manually curated dictionary in tail_segments_3.py; whole target occurrences protected; no automatic dictionary sense selection.

postOverlayAudit.targetChunkPolicy: All 311 cases reviewed in four complete batches: valid lexical compounds, personal/place names, botanical/zoological/chemical terms, reduplication, or an entire semantic noun phrase containing the target; retained the meaningful unit instead of splitting its constituent character artificially.
postOverlayAudit.polysemyContextAudit: Two exhaustive context enumerations checked sensitive lexical rules throughout assigned examples; added guards for 一家人, 人来人往, 生气 vitality, 散发 hair, 打成 rapport, and 流口水. Final suspect-gloss scan checked all 5150 overlaid examples and found one missed false compound 不随意 (unconscious), now split into 不 / 随意.
postOverlayAudit.validatorCorrections: Unicode case-insensitive pinyin includes initial É; literal English see retained as a legitimate verb meaning.
